questions.q: Explain the three senses in which the United States exercises hegemony in world politics.
answer: After the end of the Cold War, the United States emerged as the sole superpower, and its hegemony can be understood in three senses.

answer.text: The first is military dominance. The United States possesses unrivalled military strength, with advanced weapons, worldwide bases and the ability to project force anywhere, as shown in the Gulf Wars. No other country can match its hard power.

The second is structural power, meaning dominance over the world economy and its institutions. The United States shaped bodies like the IMF, the World Bank and the WTO, and its ideas of trade and finance, even the internet, underpin the global system.
The third is soft power, the influence of American culture, values and way of life, spread through films, media, fashion and ideas, which shape the tastes and thinking of people worldwide.

answer: Thus US hegemony rests on military, economic and cultural dominance together.
